summary: Guard #175's saved-pin count label: the wording moves into savedPinsLabel() beside the rest of the pin vocabulary, MapPinBar reads it, and pins-test asserts the sentence a screen reader hears at 0, 1, 2 and 11

coordination.notes: mapPins.ts already owns the pin vocabulary (PIN_COLORS, PIN_ICONS, PIN_PRESETS, PIN_DRAG_TYPE) and pins-test.mjs already owns mapPins.ts, so the helper and its test go to the existing owners; nothing new is created and no second copy of the wording remains. CORRECTION: this was claimed on the belief that no test covered the label. One did - tools/sound-actions-test.mjs:19, 'saved-pin count is grammatical in both its title and accessible name' - and I missed it by grepping 'saved pin' when the name is hyphenated. It asserted the literal ternary text rather than the grammar its name promises, so it went red on a change that makes that property more true; per the read-the-name-before-the-body rule the body was changed, not the name. It now asserts only that the title and the accessible name are one computed label, and the grammar is asserted by execution in pins-test.mjs. Two suites, two propositions, no duplication. The #175 triage comment carried the same wrong claim and has been corrected on the issue. MapPinBar.tsx is also read by tools/battlespace-test.mjs, which asserts nothing about the count label and stayed green.
